title: Sweep model depth (DEPTH=8 -> 10)
description: Set DEPTH=10 (from 8), keeping ASPECT_RATIO=64 and HEAD_DIM=128; model_dim becomes 640 (5 heads), all LR/schedule logic unchanged since dmodel_lr_scale auto-adjusts.
reflection: val_bpb improved from 1.014027 to 1.002351 (-1.15%), confirming depth was an under-tuned lever in the baseline. Worth a small follow-up grid (e.g. DEPTH=9, 11, 12) to find the local optimum along this axis before moving to other ideas, since the gain came essentially free (one-line change, same training time).
